mentions.name: Dactyl Manuform mechanical keyboard build
mentions.description: This project finishes a 3D-printed Dactyl Manuform mechanical keyboard whose switches are already installed and which still needs to be soldered.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a Dactyl Manuform mechanical keyboard that's 3D printed, has the keys put in, but needs soldered up, hopefully able to knock that out soon too.
